areas.assessment: Kion’s subjective assessment of the launch-experience updates on 2026-10-10 (revision 30700f02): the shared Rappy icon, minimal fan-remake notice and quieter cached startup bring the experience to A. This records the owner’s review of the updates, not a completed exported-device playtest.
areas.next: Maintain the current presentation and finish exported-device verification. A startup movie is an optional path toward S; Kion is not prioritizing that level of polish.

areas.assessment: Kion raises Traps from D to B after the PR #761 laptop playtest on 2026-10-13. Distinct trap meshes, corrected materials and layouts, tactical enemy statuses, cycling needle/poison plates, rescuable bear traps, visible ball arming and the Coliseum trap page provide a playable tested baseline.
areas.next: Refine balance and effects in field encounters. Original hostile radii, Light confusion, exact environmental timing/damage parity and the broader status/weapon-element audit remain open; intentional owner-directed remake behavior is documented in trap-validation.
areas.label: score:traps

areas.assessment: Kion raises Bosses from D to C on 2026-10-13: the existing boss encounters have received a first pass and work mechanically, even though they are not 1:1 with the original. This owner assessment follows the playable Shrine, Reyburn/Octo, Paru robot and Arca Humilias work in PRs #753, #754, #756, #757 and #758. Reyburn and Octo were accepted in Mac playtests for #754; the later Reyburn behavior and canyon backdrop were accepted on 2026-10-12 for #758 (behavior revision 08afa91f). This is a playable-mechanics baseline, not full original-game fidelity or complete campaign validation.
areas.next: Refine boss feel, balance, hit geometry, effects and original behavior from the playable baseline. Remaining work includes Octo swallow/escape, robot targeting/movement and floor/status variants, Trinity piece visuals and attack delivery, and Falz form progression. Review campaign boss assignments and the Trinity-to-Falz handoff separately from the dedicated arena encounters. Complete Tower Mother placement/validation and the new Snowfield/Makara encounter designs; these are not covered by the existing-boss first pass.
areas.label: score:bosses

areas.assessment: Basic mechanics exist; lock-on and better enemy behavior are still needed.
areas.next: Specify lock-on, validate enemy families and review attack rhythm, hit alignment and recovery in play.
areas.label: score:combat

areas.assessment: Kion raises Systems from D to C after local Mac playtesting of PR #752 (6c2230c2 plus the playtest fixes committed in this PR) on 2026-10-11. Combat progression, inventory grinding with visible per-instance ATP and grind levels, dedicated Photon Blast activation and the segmented HUD gauge now support the core loop. The Coliseum exit blocker was reproduced and fixed with regression coverage; broader balance and fidelity work remain.
areas.next: Playtest Equip → Sets (save/recall, bank retrieval, missing-item refusal, controller naming) and the EXP bar/level-up flash. Verify multi-area enemy levels and both death paths. Continue quest and free-roam playtesting after the Coliseum exit fix. Validate economy, class/EXP and enemy-level tuning, weapon specials/status fidelity, technique weapons and party Photon Blast behavior. Coliseum now exposes player/enemy levels, scaled HP previews and debug invincibility; verify hands-on tuning and controller use. Existing traversal defects remain separate follow-up work. Grade and assessment date unchanged.
areas.label: score:systems
